note: Creature definitions referenced by a transform or a summon. A shape-shifting feature references a form slot by id; a summon references a companion by id. The individual monster and beast stat blocks live in creatures.json and are authored in a later phase. A form slot only needs the CR cap, because a caster chooses any creature at or below it.

forms.name: Any Beast CR 1/4 or Lower
forms.note: Must have no flying or swimming speed. PHB Wild Shape, Druid level 2.

forms.name: Any Beast CR 1/2 or Lower
forms.note: Must have no flying speed. PHB Wild Shape, Druid level 4.

forms.name: Any Beast CR 1 or Lower
forms.note: PHB Wild Shape, Druid level 8.

forms.name: Any Beast CR 2 or Lower
forms.note: PHB Wild Shape, Druid level 11.

forms.name: Any Beast CR 4 or Lower
forms.note: PHB Wild Shape, Druid level 17.

forms.name: Any Humanoid of Your Level
forms.cr: equal to the changeling's own level
forms.note: Changeling Duplicate Form replaces the changeling's game statistics with those of another humanoid of the same level, keeping their own Wisdom, Charisma and Intelligence, and keeps their own size, speed, languages and ability scores. The humanoid stat block itself is chosen at the table and is not fixed data. Volo's Guide to Allies p. 41.

forms.name: Any Beast CR Equal to or Below Yours
forms.cr: equal to the shifter's own CR, or lower
forms.note: The Shifting trait takes the statistics of a Medium beast whose challenge rating is equal to or lower than the shifter's, while the shifter keeps Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma and all other racial and class features. Authored per-beast in creatures.json.

forms.name: Wisp
forms.note: A translucent spectral form with no audible presence, in which the Dhampir is blinded and deafened and can't interact with objects. A creature can attack a wisp only if it can see the wisp, within 5 feet, and succeeds on a Constitution saving throw, taking 1d4 radiant damage and falling to 0 hit points if it fails. If the Dhampir is reduced to 0 hit points while a wisp, they revert to their normal form and are immune to the wisp's damage for 24 hours. VgtM Dhampir.

forms.name: Autonyme Duplicate
forms.note: A nonmagical copy created by the Autonyme Duplicate trait. It shares the automne's game statistics but has no equipment, and has 10% of the automne's hit points, rounded up. It is 10 feet tall and weighs 300 pounds. PHB mirror image, Eberron p. 22.

forms.name: Wildfire Spirit
forms.size: the size of your Medium form
forms.note: Invisible and represented by a spectral flame. Takes actions on its own turn, and can use its reaction when you cast a spell. If the druid is level 4 or lower the spirit is CR 0 and a Small fey spirit. PHB Druid Circle of Land 14.

forms.name: Elixir Cannon
forms.note: A Small wooden magical cannon, crafted in 1 hour and 25 gp after a long rest. It occupies a space you can see within 5 feet of you and can use Arcane Firearm, Explosive Cannon and Fortified Position. Tasha's Cauldron p. 48.

forms.name: Steel Defender
forms.note: A magical construct crafted in 1 hour and 500 gp after a long rest. It acts on its own turn in combat, can make Arcane Jolt as a bonus action, is commanded by bonus action, and ends after 1 hour, three attacks, or if you take exhaustion. Tasha's Cauldron p. 49.

forms.name: Ancestral Guardian Spirit
forms.hp: equal to half your barbarian level
forms.note: A Large spectral spirit of your ancestors' afterlife, appearing for the duration of your rage and acting on its own turn. Cannot be targeted by attacks, spells, or other means of perception or harm. PHB Barbarian Ancestral Guardian 3.

forms.name: Phantom Watchdog
forms.note: An invisible spectral watchdog conjured by the Shadow Magic origin's Hound of Ill Omen, in place of a familiar. It has a +4 bonus to attack rolls and deals 1d8 piercing damage on a hit, and cannot be targeted by creatures other than its sorcerer. PHB Sorcerer Shadow Magic 6.

forms.name: Boggle
forms.note: A fey spirit in the shape of a candle snuffer, with a salamander's fiery breath and the distilling breath of a sprite. Summoned by Fey Reinforcements, CR equal to half the ranger level at 17th.

forms.name: Gathered Swarm
forms.note: A Large swarm of tiny insectile creatures, summoned by Gathered Swarm when you drop to 0 hit points. Acts immediately, takes its own turns, and vanishes at the end of your next turn. Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes p. 160.

forms.name: Hexblade's Accursed Specter
forms.note: A translucent phantom warrior conjured by the Hexblade patron's Accursed Specter. It occupies your space, requires no slot, lasts 1 minute or until it takes 30 damage, and can attack anyone but you within 5 feet for 1d6 necrotic damage. PHB Warlock Hexblade 6.

forms.name: Awakened Familiar
forms.hp: a quarter of your caster's hit dice
forms.note: The thrall created by the Great Old One's Create Thrall. It is the same creature as the one created by the find familiar spell, of the same type, with the same statistics, except that it uses your spell save DC as its spell save DC and its attack bonus is equal to your spell attack modifier, and it is intangible rather than invisible. PHB Warlock Great Old One 14.

forms.name: Starry Form
forms.note: The astral form a Circle of Stars druid assumes with Starry Form. Grants a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DC, any spell cast in it ignores half cover, and the form lasts 1 hour. Tasha's Cauldron p. 44.

forms.name: Mighty Nature Spirit
forms.cr: equal to your spirit totem's creature
forms.note: A spirit summoned by Mighty Summoner. It has its own initiative and turns, acts immediately on its turn, and can take reactions. At 14th level the druid may summon a Large or smaller creature from any spirit totem type. PHB Druid Circle of the Shepherd 6.

forms.name: Flames of the Phoenix
forms.hp: equal to your monk hit points
forms.note: The flame form a Way of the Four Elements monk assumes with Flames of the Phoenix. Grants a +2 bonus to AC, resistance to all damage except psychic, and its melee attacks deal an extra 1d6 fire damage. Tasha's Cauldron p. 88.

forms.name: Echo Knight Echo
forms.ac: half your AC, plus 2 at 7th and your Charisma modifier at 18th
forms.hp: half your maximum hit points, plus your fighter level times 5 at 18th
forms.speed: 30 ft., teleports to you when it takes damage, taking 5d10 psychic
forms.note: A magical echo of the fighter, created with Manifest Echo or Unleash Incarnation. Intangible, makes attack rolls as the fighter does, can take reactions and use their features, and is destroyed at 0 hit points or by a Dispel Evil or similar. Tasha's Cauldron p. 73.
